description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) scores for different Large Language Models (LLMs) under varying conditions of Simulated Fine-Tuning (SFT). The horizontal axis represents the LLM, with categories labeled “LLaMA-2-7B”, “LLaMA-2-13B”, and “LLaMA-2-70B” in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-R (%)”, represents the score, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  There are four bars for each LLM category, grouped side-by-side. The first bar in each group is yellow and labeled “no SFT”, with a height of approximately 65% for LLaMA-2-7B, 70% for LLaMA-2-13B, and 72% for LLaMA-2-70B. The second bar in each group is light orange and labeled “+ SFT on D₀”, with heights of approximately 68%, 75%, and 78% respectively. The third bar is light red and labeled “+ SFT on D₀, D₁”, with heights of approximately 72%, 79%, and 80% respectively. The final bar in each group is pink and labeled “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”, with heights of approximately 74%, 79%, and 79% respectively. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each LLM, and the groups are ordered alphabetically by LLM name. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
